title: Manifest — begin your Career Map
objective_short: Capture self-knowledge and build your copy-ready Career Map fields.

title: Path of Roots
objective_short: Attune the grove shrine beneath the sentinel oak.

title: Quest of Fate — consult the Oracle
objective_short: Receive a prophecy and record your Destiny Number.

title: Quest of Fate — open the Vault of Runes
objective_short: Use your Destiny Number to open the correct research portal and begin evidence gathering.

title: Fog of the Unknown — map the realms
objective_short: After the Vault, use the World Map ledger while you explore; if your Scroll lists three Foretold Signposts, save a comparison from each of those tiles first (then keep charting the full map).

title: Loose Leaves of the Ledger

title: Guild Atlas — Pulse Reading
objective_short: Log one realm entry in the atlas after the main path trial.

title: Echo at the Haven
objective_short: Hear three traveler stories linked to career clusters.

title: GT-101 — Complete the Enrollment Rune
objective_short: Submit a formal application with professionalism and complete required fields.

title: GT-102 — Pass the Trial of Tongues
objective_short: Complete the interview trial and earn the Guild’s approval.
